ORDINANCE Dé. 12,2023

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11-1 in the area bounded by:

West Lawrence Avenue; the public alley next east of North Manor Avenue; the public
alley next south and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; and a line 50.00 feet east of and
parallel to North Manor Avenue

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Address: 2917 — 35 West Lawrence Avenue, Chicago, IL
